description: Zone de développement de l'éolien (ZDE) autorisée de la région Lorraine is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carmen.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. As the regulations have changed, this data is disseminated on an historical basis. Wind development areas (EEZs) are defined, on the proposal of the municipalities concerned, according to winds (“wind potential”), the possibilities for connection to the electricity grids, public safety, the protection of landscapes, biodiversity, historical monuments, archaeological heritage and remarkable and protected ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Authorised Wind Development Zone (DEZ) of the Lorraine region" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2013-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
